title: Citrix security advisory (AV26-965)
description: As of September 27, 2026, Citrix is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products:
products:
NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway 14.1
	Prior to 14.1-73.37

NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway 13.1
	Prior to 13.1-63.23

NetScaler ADC FIPS
	Prior to 14.1-73.37 FIPS

NetScaler ADC FIPS and NDcPP
	Prior to 13.1-37.279
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
